description: Source code for ExecutorPodsAllocator class in Apache Spark, managing Kubernetes executor pods including creation, deletion, PVC reuse, and snapshot handling.

classes.name: ExecutorPodsAllocator
classes.description: Manages Kubernetes executor pods, including creation, deletion, PVC reuse, and snapshot processing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the allocator, waits for driver pod readiness, and subscribes to snapshot updates.

methods.name: setTotalExpectedExecutors
methods.description: Sets the expected number of executors per resource profile.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if an executor ID has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: onNewSnapshots
methods.description: Processes new executor pod snapshots, handles timeouts, deletions, and requests new executors.

methods.name: getReusablePVCs
methods.description: Retrieves reusable PersistentVolumeClaims based on labels and creation time.

methods.name: requestNewExecutors
methods.description: Creates new executor pods and associated PVCs, handling PVC reuse.

methods.name: replacePVCsIfNeeded
methods.description: Replaces PVCs in pod specs with reusable ones if available.

methods.name: isExecutorIdleTimedOut
methods.description: Determines if an executor pod has timed out based on creation timestamp.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deletes all executor pods associated with the application ID.
